faq.title: Your Questions, Answered
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before booking your first clean.

items.question: How far in advance should I book?
items.answer: We recommend booking at least 48 hours ahead, but same-day and emergency slots are often available. Book online 24/7 for real-time scheduling.

items.question: Do you bring your own supplies?
items.answer: Yes! We arrive with all professional-grade, eco-friendly supplies and equipment. Just point us to the spaces you'd like cleaned.

items.question: What if I'm not satisfied?
items.answer: We stand behind our work 100%. If anything falls short of perfection, let us know within 24 hours and we'll re-clean it at no charge.

items.question: Can I customize my cleaning?
items.answer: Absolutely. Use the notes at checkout to specify priorities, off-limits areas, or special instructions for your cleaner.
